name: opencode
description:
Execute complex SOFTWARE DEVELOPMENT tasks: coding, building apps/websites/APIs, deploying services, git operations, and multi-step programming workflows.

Use this when:
- User wants to BUILD SOFTWARE (apps, websites, APIs, scripts)
- User says 'code', 'develop', 'deploy', 'make an app/website'
- Task requires writing multiple files, tests, or package.json/requirements.txt
- Task needs a full project structure with README

Do NOT use for:
- Simple document generation (PDFs, reports) → use pdf_create instead
- Downloading images or files → use stash instead
- Text formatting or markdown → use canvas instead
- One-off shell commands → use execute_bash instead
- API calls → use api_call instead

task.description: Detailed description of the task to execute. Be specific about what needs to be done. If web server, use non standard port.

task_type.description: Type of task - determines workspace and permissions (optional, defaults to 'general')

session_id.description: Optional: OpenCode session ID to resume previous conversation/task or check logs

agent_mode.description: OpenCode agent mode. Use 'build' for implementation with full permissions and 'plan' for read-only analysis that may ask before changes.
